verdict.summary: The added sweep-level regression test exercises the real terminal-reap path at the relevant mutation boundary. With the initial open-issue listing empty in all three legs, it distinguishes a fresh direct read showing an open non-terminal issue (claim retained) from both a 404-equivalent absence and a closed issue (claim released). The combined assertions cover both fail-closed retention and continued legitimate reaping, record exceptions as values so a crash cannot masquerade as detection, and verify the release set as well as the summary count. The accompanying rationale is consistent with the existing direct-read revalidation flow. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-vacuity issue is evident in the diff.
